statement: The bridge converts transactions from one AXI4 Manager into ordered APB4 transfers through one APB port.
The bridge uses one shared clock and has only one global transaction active at a time.
The bridge supports AXI4 read/write channels, FIXED/INCR/WRAP bursts, 32-bit addresses/data, 1/2/4-byte transfers, IDs, PSTRB, PPROT, error propagation and defensive request rejection.
AxPROT passes through to PPROT.
The RTL design must follow the VLSIT RTL Design Rules v2 as the mandatory RTL baseline.

not_verified.note: VLSIT RTL coding rules; checked by lint and review.

statement: A product choice must not weaken a protocol requirement of the selected standards.

not_verified.note: Policy statement about how the documents rank; nothing to observe. Protocol requirements are checked by CHK-001..CHK-017.

statement: The bridge shall convert each accepted AXI transaction into ordered APB transfers and return its AXI completion.
The bridge shall keep at most one global read or write transaction active at any time.
The bridge shall arbitrate between AR and AW by round-robin.
The bridge shall choose AR for the first tie after reset.
The bridge shall flip the next tie preference between AR and AW after each completed transaction.
The bridge shall accept an AXI transfer only when VALID and READY are both high at rising ACLK.
The bridge shall support FIXED bursts of 1–16 beats, INCR bursts of 1–256 beats, and WRAP bursts of 2, 4, 8 or 16 beats.
The bridge shall support AxSIZE values 0, 1 and 2 (1, 2, 4 bytes).
The bridge shall reject unsupported size/burst and 4-KiB-crossing transactions without any APB access.
The bridge shall align APB PADDR down to a four-byte word boundary.
The bridge shall copy WSTRB to PSTRB.
The bridge shall drive PSTRB=0 on reads.
The bridge shall echo ARID on every R beat.
The bridge shall echo AWID on the corresponding B response.
The bridge shall copy AxPROT to PPROT.
The bridge shall omit AxLOCK, USER, QOS and REGION ports.

not_verified.note: Port list inspection: no AxLOCK/USER/QOS/REGION ports exist on the interface.

statement: The bridge shall accept only AxCACHE values 0000 and 0001.
The bridge shall return SLVERR without asserting PSEL.
The bridge shall not implement exclusive access.

not_verified.note: There is no AxLOCK port, so exclusive access cannot be exercised; checked by interface review.

statement: Integration shall not send exclusive traffic to the bridge.

not_verified.note: Binds the integration or Manager. Used as a stimulus constraint: no exclusive traffic is generated.

statement: The bridge shall hold AXI VALID and payload stable through the handshake.
The bridge shall hold APB control and payload stable while PREADY=0.
The bridge shall use one shared ACLK/PCLK domain.

not_verified.note: Single clock domain; checked by CDC analysis and port inspection.

statement: The bridge shall contain no asynchronous clock crossing.

not_verified.note: No asynchronous crossing; checked by CDC analysis.

statement: The bridge shall use one active-low reset synchronous to ACLK.

not_verified.note: Reset structure (single, active-low, synchronous) is a lint/structure property. The reset values that result are checked in CHK-017 and CHK-031.

statement: The SoC shall supply the reset synchronized to ACLK.

not_verified.note: Binds the SoC reset generator. The testbench drives i_rst_n_axi synchronously to i_clk_axi.

statement: AXI VALID outputs shall be low while reset is sampled active.
PARA_AXI_ID_W shall range from 1 to 16, with default 4.

not_verified.note: Parameter range and default; elaboration sweep across separate builds (designer decision on AB-8-03).

statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W shall set both read and write ID widths.

not_verified.note: Shared ID width for read and write ports; port-width property of the elaboration, checked across separate builds.

statement: An unsupported read shall return ARLEN+1 R beats with SLVERR.
RLAST shall be asserted only on the final beat of an unsupported read.
The bridge shall not perform APB access for an unsupported read.
The bridge shall map read PSLVERR to SLVERR on that R beat.
The bridge shall accumulate write errors into the final BRESP after all declared W beats.
The bridge shall drain AWLEN+1 W beats for an unsupported write.
The bridge shall not perform APB access for an unsupported write.
The bridge shall then return one SLVERR B response.
The external APB fabric shall provide a default unmapped Completer with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1.

not_verified.note: Binds the external APB fabric. A default completer is modelled in the testbench for CHK-026.

statement: The bridge shall have no APB timeout.
The bridge shall hold the APB access while PREADY=0 and wait indefinitely if PREADY never rises.
A completed APB transfer with PSLVERR=1 shall cause the associated AXI response to be SLVERR.
The bridge shall contain no software-visible CSR interface.

not_verified.note: No CSR interface; checked by port inspection.

statement: Verification shall derive expected results from this specification and cited standards, never from generated RTL.

not_verified.note: Verification methodology rule. This plan derives expected results from the spec only.

statement: Verification deliverables shall retain generated testbench sources and commands.

not_verified.note: Rule about keeping verification deliverables (artifact audit).

statement: Verification shall use one Makefile as the documented command entry point.

not_verified.note: Rule about the verification flow entry point (Makefile).

statement: CFG-BASE shall provide a full AXI4 Subordinate and an APB4 Manager with legal FIXED/INCR/WRAP bursts and ID echo.
CFG-BASE shall not include CDC, timeout, CSR, exclusive access, or USER/QOS/REGION features (disabled).

not_verified.note: Missing CDC/CSR/exclusive/USER/QOS/REGION features is a structural property. The absence of a timeout is exercised by CHK-018.

statement: The AXI ID width may be configured at elaboration.

not_verified.note: Elaboration-time configurability; a parameter sweep is not a single-simulation test.

statement: m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl arbitrates between AR and AW requests in round-robin order.
AXI response backpressure must stall the sequencer that owns the transaction.
m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl retains the transaction owner until the final R or B response completes.
The bridge performs one APB read per beat in AXI order, then presents RVALID/RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID and holds them until RREADY.
The bridge accepts AW first and then W beats in order.
The master may assert WVALID before the AW address is accepted.
WREADY must remain low until AW has been accepted.
The bridge performs one APB write per beat and returns B only after the last APB completion.
APB payload and control signals must remain stable during wait.
IDs are retained and echoed unchanged in the response (RID equals ARID, BID equals AWID).
The read beat count is ARLEN+1 and the legal write beat count is AWLEN+1.
AXI response payload must remain stable while VALID=1 and READY=0.
The bridge must implement the required AXI4 (IHI 0022 H.c) Subordinate interface IF-001 on CLK-AXI in CFG-BASE.
The bridge must implement the required APB4 (IHI 0024 D) Manager/Requester interface IF-002 on CLK-AXI with PCLK=ACLK in CFG-BASE.
APB setup phase must have o_apb_psel=1 and o_apb_penable=0; access phase has both 1 and completes when i_apb_pready=1.
o_axi_bid and o_axi_bresp must remain stable until the B handshake completes.
o_axi_bid and o_axi_bresp must be 0 in reset.
o_axi_rid, o_axi_rdata and o_axi_rresp must remain stable until the R handshake completes.
o_axi_rid, o_axi_rdata and o_axi_rresp must be 0 in reset.
o_axi_rlast must be high only on the final read beat.
o_apb_paddr, o_apb_pwrite and o_apb_pprot must remain stable through the transfer.
o_apb_paddr, o_apb_pwrite, o_apb_pwdata, o_apb_pstrb and o_apb_pprot must be 0 when idle.
o_apb_paddr must be a word-aligned byte address.
o_apb_pwdata must remain stable during wait states.
o_apb_pstrb must remain stable through the access.
o_apb_pstrb must be zero on reads.
o_apb_pprot must be a copy of the corresponding AxPROT.
A legal AXI read (FIXED/INCR/WRAP, size 0–2, cache 0000/0001) must be supported and performed as APB transfers.
The bridge must issue no APB transfer and return ARLEN+1 R beats with RRESP SLVERR.
A legal AXI write consists of an AW request followed by the declared number of W beats; W data may arrive before AW.
The bridge must issue no APB transfer, drain the W beats, then return a B response with SLVERR.
The bridge must perform one APB transfer per AXI beat.
The bridge must hold the APB access indefinitely and not time out.
The bridge must sample PSLVERR on the completed APB transfer.
The bridge must return the read beat with RRESP SLVERR, treating read data as invalid.
The bridge must accumulate the write error and report it in BRESP.
The external default Completer must respond with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1, and the bridge must then return AXI SLVERR.
The bridge must reject the request before issuing any APB traffic.
A burst must not cross a 4-KiB address boundary.

not_verified.note: Binds the AXI Manager. Legal stimulus never crosses 4 KiB; deliberate crossings test the bridge's rejection in CHK-022/CHK-023.

statement: The SoC must provide i_rst_n_axi synchronous to CLK-AXI (i_clk_axi).

not_verified.note: Binds the SoC reset source. Used as a testbench constraint.

statement: PSEL and PENABLE must be 0 after the active reset edge, and AXI VALID outputs must be 0 during reset.
Reset is sampled on the rising edge of i_clk_axi, and i_rst_n_axi must be kept active for at least one rising edge.

not_verified.note: Binds the reset driver (at least one active edge). The testbench always holds reset for 1 or more edges.

statement: The SoC owns reset synchronization and must coordinate the reset of the AXI Manager with the APB fabric.

not_verified.note: System-level reset coordination owned by the SoC.

statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W must be declared as parameter logic [31:0] with default value 4.

not_verified.note: Parameter declaration type and default; checked by source review.

statement: The comments Parameter Description, Parameter values and Parameter unit must immediately precede the PARA_AXI_ID_W declaration.

not_verified.note: Comment placement (designer decision): lint/review only.

statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W legal range is 1 to 16 inclusive; any invalid value must cause an elaboration error.

not_verified.note: Elaboration error for an illegal width (designer decision): not covered by a single legal simulation.

statement: PARA_AXI_ID_W must set the width of the AXI read/write ID ports, shared between read and write.

not_verified.note: ID port width set by the parameter; elaboration/port property.

statement: Address, data and APB widths must be fixed at 32 bits.

not_verified.note: Fixed 32-bit address/data widths are port-width properties.

statement: CFG-BASE must elaborate with hierarchy m_axi2apb_bridge containing m_axi2apb_rd_seq, m_axi2apb_wr_seq and m_axi2apb_apb_ctrl, and ID widths 1, 4, 16 must pass elaboration, lint and synthesis checks.

not_verified.note: Hierarchy and the elaboration/lint/synthesis sweep for ID widths 1, 4, 16.

statement: A burst that crosses a 4-KiB boundary must be rejected.
The 32-bit data path must not rotate byte lanes between AXI and APB.
The AXI ID must be echoed unchanged in the response without remapping.
AxSIZE values other than 0, 1 and 2 must be rejected.
A reserved AxBURST value must be rejected; FIXED, INCR and WRAP are the legal values.
AxCACHE encodings other than 0000 and 0001 must be rejected; AxCACHE is used for validation only.
AxPROT must be copied directly to PPROT with no translation.
For subword writes, WSTRB must be copied to PSTRB unchanged.
APB PADDR must be word-aligned.
In IDLE the bridge arbitrates between AR and AW and selects a transaction upon address handshake.
In WRITE the bridge accepts W, performs an APB write per beat, returns one B, and exits on B handshake.
Reset returns the bridge to IDLE, clears local state, deselects APB, and cancels in-flight work.
A read performs an APB read per beat, holds the address for FIXED and follows AXI address rules for INCR and WRAP, returns ARLEN+1 R beats with RID echoed and final RLAST, serialized.
A write performs an APB write per beat, maps WSTRB to PSTRB, accumulates PSLVERR, and returns one B only after final APB completion, serialized.
An unsupported read performs no APB access and returns ARLEN+1 R beats with SLVERR and zero data, honoring RREADY.
An unsupported write performs no APB access, drains the declared W count, and returns one SLVERR B after the final W.
PSLVERR on a read beat marks that beat's response as error.
Write PSLVERR accumulates, later beats still execute, and final BRESP is SLVERR.
The bridge has no internal APB timeout; it must not abort an APB transfer by timeout.
Signals are sampled on the rising edge of CLK-AXI.

not_verified.note: Sampling convention. All checks in this plan sample on the rising edge of i_clk_axi.

statement: APB setup is PSEL=1/PENABLE=0, access is PSEL=1/PENABLE=1, and completion requires PREADY=1.
AR/AW arbitration is round-robin when both are pending.
The selected transaction owns the bridge until its final R handshake or B handshake.
Respond with ARLEN+1 SLVERR read beats carrying zero data and RLAST on the final beat, without issuing any APB access.
Do not generate any APB transfer for an unsupported read.
Drain the expected count of W beats, then complete the write with a B response of SLVERR, without any APB access.
Do not generate any APB transfer for an unsupported write.
Return RRESP=SLVERR with RDATA=0 for the beat, and continue processing the remaining beats.
Accumulate the error, continue the remaining write beats, and return final BRESP=SLVERR.
Hold the APB access indefinitely with no timeout until the completer responds or system reset occurs.
Reset deselects the APB completer.
Default Completer drives PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1, and the bridge reports an AXI SLVERR response.
Never report an APB failure as AXI OKAY.
The RTL must not define expected results; expected results come from the independent reference model.

not_verified.note: Verification methodology. The reference models in the CHK-014/CHK-016 trackers come from the spec.

statement: The independent model must match the bridge addresses, data and responses for FIXED, INCR and WRAP bursts with legal sizes.
Payload must remain stable through APB wait states and RREADY/BREADY stalls, checked by assertions.
The SoC integrator must provide clock period, uncertainty, transition, latency, interface delays, loads, PVT/RC corners and timing modes before timing closure.

not_verified.note: Timing-closure inputs supplied by the SoC integrator.

statement: A later timing exception must have exact endpoints, mode, rationale and CDC/RDC evidence.

not_verified.note: Timing constraint/exception content; STA review.

statement: Broad timing exceptions must not be used.

not_verified.note: Bans broad timing exceptions; STA/SDC review.

statement: The bridge must map AxPROT to PPROT.
The bridge must not perform a local access-control check on PPROT; APB Completers enforce PPROT.
The bridge must propagate errors and provide no interrupt or status mechanism.
The bridge must support the conversion profile: FIXED/INCR/WRAP burst types, legal lengths, 1/2/4-byte transfer sizes, and PSTRB/PPROT conversion.
The bridge has no timeout or CSR, so the system must provide a default APB error Completer.

not_verified.note: System must provide a default APB error completer. Modelled in CHK-026.

statement: Any lint finding must be fixed or reported under the skill rules, with no project-specific waivers.

not_verified.note: Lint finding handling policy.

statement: The AXI Manager must comply with AXI4 WLAST/AWLEN and WSTRB rules; no RTL recovery is defined for malformed write traffic.

not_verified.note: Binds the AXI Manager. All stimulus obeys the WLAST/AWLEN/WSTRB rules; malformed writes are not generated.

statement: Reset must cancel local state without replay or rollback, which requires coordinated system reset.
The APB address map/decoder must provide a match or a default response with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1.

not_verified.note: Binds the APB address decoder/fabric. Modelled in CHK-026.
